_doc: Heart Raid (prototype, docs/design/PVE_HEART_RAID.md): the PvE mode on the expedition map. One squad of 1-4 Hunters (bots fill a squad of 4 offline) holds the Heart against waves and one boss while the Blight's tide closes. scripts/match/heart_raid.gd runs it. Seconds on the session clock, metres; the tide itself is heart.json's.
_match_s: the islands fall this many seconds in: the raid is lost if the squad has not won by then
_wave_every_s: a new wave this often; the last wave of the list ends the wave phase
_boss_s: the boss comes at this time, or boss_after_clear_s after the last wave is cleared, whichever is first

boss.name: Blighted Cairnback
boss._doc: the one prototype boss: a Lair boss kit (scripts/match/boss.gd) fought in the open around the Heart, named for the Boki it is (content/kin/*.json "boss"). hp is for a squad of 4 at tier 1 before scale.boss_hp; enrage = seconds before it hits harder (a Lair's is 75); half = the half-width in metres of the square it fights in, centred on the Heart

_heart_r: a wave's "heart" monsters come out of the ground this far from the Heart and guard it
_edge_back: a wave's "edge" monsters come from the Blight's side: this far from the squad, on the line from the Heart through the squad
_steer_r: a wave monster with nobody to fight goes for the nearest standing Hunter of the squad this close
_rally_r: bot Hunters of the squad farther than this from the fight's centre (the Heart, then the boss) are pinged back to it

scale._doc: by squad size 1..4 (every Hunter in the squad, bots too): wave headcount, monster health, boss health, the cap on wave monsters alive at once

_blight_lvl: strength of the Blight monsters a wave brings (BlightDir.spawn level; 1 = full)

reward._doc: paid to each Hunter who holds the Heart ring once the boss is down (Heart.pay reads this in a Heart Raid). An egg of a raid-only Boki (content/kin/*.json "only_in": "heart_raid"), fewer gems than the Expedition's major seat
